offers_products.reason: Sells electricity from Merom power plant and coal from Sunrise Coal mines; both are commodity products.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from selling power and coal; logistics supports its own supply chain, not a main service offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells power to utilities and grid markets and coal to power plants, not to households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are utilities, grid operators (MISO) and power producers buying electricity, capacity and coal.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing power and capacity sales and multi-year coal supply contracts to repeat utility customers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Always-on electricity and fuel for grid reliability; demand is largely non-discretionary and contracted.

big_ticket.reason: Frequent deliveries of coal and continuous electricity and capacity sales, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from the power plant and coal mines, which are assets, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are large utilities, grid operators and power generators.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates the Merom power plant and underground coal mines, and plans a new gas plant.
